name: android-architecture-design
description: Android Clean Architecture, XML MVVM, Compose MVI, and Material 3 UI/UX development and review guidance.

interface.shortDescription: Android architecture and Material 3 design guidance
interface.longDescription: Develop, design, review, and prepare releases within an existing Android project. Support mixed XML and Compose code, apply architecture, performance, data, and policy guidance selectively, and report evidence after proofreading and review.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this Android project's architecture and Material 3 design and explain relevant gaps.
Implement this feature within the existing project, preserving suitable choices. For new independent screens, default to XML MVVM or lightweight Compose MVI. Explain changes and verification.
Assess this Android app's Google Play readiness, including current policy, target SDK adaptation, and remaining blockers.
Review this change for typos, logic errors, anti-patterns, Android conventions, performance, and memory leaks. Cite concrete evidence.
